Context: 4. For Family Planning :

- (v) husband undergoes vasectomy operation.  
Extension/ Additional Special Casual Leave is admissible for the period of hospitalization if the concerned employee is hospitalized on account of post-operational complications. -Appendix-Ill.  
Not admissible to Temporary Status Casual labourers.Special Casual Leave for sterilization operation is not admissible to casual labourers with temporary status since the benefit is admissible to regular employees only.
